items.name: visit
items.signature: fn visit<V: Visitor>(hir: &hir::Hir, visitor: V) -> Result<V::Output, V::Err>
items.summary: Executes an implementation of `Visitor` in constant stack space.

items.name: Visitor
items.summary: A trait for visiting the high-level IR (HIR) in depth first order.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: All implementors of `Visitor` must provide a `finish` method, which yields the result of visiting the HIR or an error.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: This method is called before beginning traversal of the HIR.

methods.name: visit_alternation_in
methods.summary: This method is called between child nodes of an alternation.

methods.name: visit_concat_in
methods.summary: This method is called between child nodes of a concatenation.

methods.name: visit_post
methods.summary: This method is called on an `Hir` after descending all of its child `Hir` nodes.

methods.name: visit_pre
methods.summary: This method is called on an `Hir` before descending into child `Hir` nodes.
